A newly created **Fighter** starts with 4 items (ids `[2, 15, 17, 23]`, per the comment): **Longsword, Shield, Potion, Rations**.

Defined in `worker\src\services\character.ts`:
- `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` map (Fighter entry, ~line 68)
- Granted via `grantStartingEquipment(db, characterId, cls)`, which inserts each item into `character_inventory` (quantity 1, equipped 0)
- Called from `createCharacter(...)` right after the character row is inserted
